autonomous_activity_state.verification_rule: structured causal cycles derive verified hours from the registered exact/institution/career/role/billet standard; allegiance never caps or multiplies training; planned opportunity prose never creates hours

career_state.rank_billet_span_rule: Durable rank, current billet, and current command span are separate saved facts; only explicit promotion/demotion changes rank.

command_assignment.rule: Current command span follows exact surviving/assigned Units and may change without changing durable rank.

training_regimen_migration_history.access_basis: saved equipment/loadout only; historical facility and instructor are not reconstructed

current_goals: preserve command capacity and pursue only supported military opportunities within Qin authority and resources
institutional_duties: act within current Qin political and military obligations

military_rank.rule: Only explicit career promotion/demotion changes grade; billet, casualty strength, relief, reserve status and current command span do not.

activity_contract.growth_rule: verified elapsed hours settle only through the finite deterministic training-program registry selected from saved role/billet; current stat ranking and prose-created focuses are non-authoritative
